author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing Spa-Francorchamps: Rain, Dust and Evening Light
description: A gallery of iRacing clips at Spa-Francorchamps. Wet GT3 packs, dust, the long climb and evening light, all in a racing simulator.

sections.p: This post is about iRacing. iRacing is a racing simulator. It is not real life. Every clip here comes from the sim.
All of these clips were recorded at Spa-Francorchamps. Some are in the rain. Some are in dust, daylight or low evening sun. Many are from a Porsche cockpit.

list: A GT3 pack in the wet, with a Porsche, a red Ferrari and a yellow-green Lamborghini.
A car runs off the track and ends up against the fence. Race control shows an off-track message.
A Fuel Level alarm flashes on the Porsche dash in the final seconds of one rainy clip.
Dust rises at the track edge while I follow a white BMW M4 GT3 in an IMSA multiclass session.
Chasing a green GT car all the way up the long hill in evening light.
Leaving the pit lane at the speed limit, then going up through the gears onto the track.
Quiet laps through the pine forest past the red-and-yellow kerbs, with no other car in view.

sections.p: Spa-Francorchamps is in Belgium. Its lap is 7.004 km. I also watched the real thing from the stands: the 2025 Belgian GP. To drive it yourself, read the iRacing guide to Spa.

faqs.q: Is this real racing or iRacing?
faqs.a: It is iRacing. iRacing is a racing simulator, so these clips are not real life.
They are set at Spa-Francorchamps in Belgium. The lap there is 7.004 km.

faqs.q: What conditions are in the clips?
faqs.a: Some clips are in the rain and mist. Others show dust at the track edge, daylight or low evening light.
